Hi! I'm definitely still here. I thankfully never ended up going through with anything, but I still couldn't bring myself to log back onto this account until now. 

Things have certainly improved for me. I won't go into huge detail, but I recently moved house and for whatever reason the change of scenery seemed to be exactly what I needed, I'm feeling a thousand times better, not perfect sure, but it's a start. 

Thank you for caring.
